_bsd_stack_.description: Preserved Business Strategy Domain stack providing the authoritative stakeholder-defined boundaries for downstream observation and generation.
instruction: Treat the BSD stack as preserved upstream input.
Do not rename, merge, split, reorder, reinterpret, or redefine any BSD.
Do not infer academic validity or disciplinary structure directly from BSD names.
Use BSDs as observation boundaries rather than as academic classification containers.
Allow downstream observations to associate the same knowledge domain with multiple BSDs without requiring exclusive BSD ownership.
